criteria.reasoning: The memo identifies that Desai's $250 gift "was entered twice", as G-41817 imported from PayBridge transaction pbt_7Q6M77 and as G-41822 entered manually on 2026-07-16. It directs "Delete the later-entered posting (G-41822) and keep the posting tied to the source (G-41817)" and reduces the total by $250.

The memo states the gift "was keyed into the CRM for $15,000.00, but the source check (#4410, deposit RDC-0710-1) was written for $1,500.00". It directs "Edit G-41809 to change the amount to $1,500.00", a $13,500 reduction.
For G-41809 the memo directs "Void the acknowledgment sent on 2026-07-13 and send a corrected acknowledgment".

The memo identifies check #2231 ($500) as "returned for insufficient funds (NSF) on 2026-07-16". It directs "Do not delete the original gift. Post a reversing adjustment (a negative gift for the full amount of −$500.00) dated 2026-07-16 in a July batch."

The memo identifies the postmark of 2026-06-30 and moves G-41803 "from July batch B-2607-01 to the year-end batch B-2606-YE". It never re-dates the gift to its 2026-06-30 postmark date, which the criterion's PASS text requires. The adjusting entry is silent on the gift date, so it is incomplete under the criterion.
The memo makes no adjustment to G-41802 (Doyle) or G-41804 (Ochieng). Both remain in the July batches, and its only fiscal-year move is the Lindgren gift.

The memo treats the fees only as a tie-out reconciling item: "PayBridge processor fees (withheld from gross transactions)". It does not call them an error, proposes no CRM entry for them, and keeps the card gifts at gross in the $17,130 corrected total.
The $86.40 Valley Office Supply refund appears only as a "Non-gift deposit" reconciling item in the bank tie-out. It is not entered in the CRM or counted in the $17,130 corrected batch total.
The memo states "Corrected July Batch Total: $17,130.00", derived from $32,380.00 less $1,000, $13,500, $500 and $250.

The tie-out runs from $17,130.00, adding the $1,000 Lindgren gift, the $500 reversal and the $86.40 refund, and subtracting the $77.87 fees, the $500 NSF debit and the $15 fee. The result is "Net Bank Deposits: $18,123.53", which the memo says "ties exactly" to the bank detail. All three required reconciling items are present and no unexplained difference remains.
